description: Load the Storytime sign-in LCP art eagerly with a priority hint, responsive srcset and sizes, and four small WebP candidates. The local Lighthouse mobile median LCP on /th/sign-in measures 2815.47 ms against the 2500 ms done-when (baseline about 4000 ms); the PM accepted this gap on 2026-11-24 as the first step. Follow-up B covers render-blocking CSS and unused JavaScript in a later track with trigger 2026-12-01. The art change joins the 30 November 2026 launch-day deploy batch and needs Daniel's deploy word; this track holds no deploy task and no traffic task.
deviation_notes: PM decision 2026-11-23. Daniel approved a speed hill climb with the words "Sounds good". Priority P1: Storytime is the critical path for the 30 Nov launch.
